name: Transfer funds between shares
description: Transfers an amount between two of a member's shares in MERIDIAN CORE, through the review screen and posting the transaction. Returns the confirmation number and both resulting balances.

inputParams.name: fromShareCode
inputParams.description: Share suffix to transfer from, e.g. S0001 or S0070-7.

inputParams.name: toShareCode
inputParams.description: Share suffix to transfer to, e.g. MMKT-2.

outputs.name: confirmationNumber
outputs.description: Extract the confirmation number value cell text

outputs.name: fromNewBalance
outputs.description: Extract the new balance for the source share after transfer

outputs.name: toNewBalance
outputs.description: Extract the new balance for the destination share after transfer
